summary: Searchable Dropdown Feature Testing Complete - All features working correctly. LED, Static Banner, and Lightbox billboard modals all have searchable dropdowns for State, Road, and Size/Type selection. Search filtering works correctly, options display with labels and descriptions.

test_credentials.note: test@example.com / test123 returned 401 - credentials may be invalid or user doesn't exist

context_for_next_testing_agent: Searchable dropdowns implemented using SearchableSelect component (cmdk + Popover). All 3 billboard types (LED, Static Banner, Lightbox) have working searchable dropdowns. Add to Cart requires authentication.

LED_Billboard_State_Dropdown_Search.description: State dropdown has search input 'Search states...', filters options as user types

LED_Billboard_Road_Dropdown_Search.description: Road dropdown has search input 'Search roads...', shows 4 road options

LED_Billboard_Size_Dropdown_Search.description: Size dropdown has search input 'Search sizes...', shows 4 size options with descriptions

LED_Billboard_Search_Filtering.description: Typing 'Kano' filters states to 'kano state', typing 'Large' filters sizes correctly

LED_Billboard_Complete_Flow.description: Select state -> road -> size -> View Packages shows available packages with Add to Cart

Static_Banner_Road_Dropdown_Search.description: Road dropdown has search functionality, shows 3 road options

Static_Banner_Type_Dropdown_Search.description: Type dropdown has search input 'Search types...', shows 4 types: Gantry, cantliver, eye catcher, 48 sheet

Lightbox_Type_Dropdown_Search.description: Type dropdown has search functionality, shows 2 types: Backlit Standard, Premium LED Backlit

Add_to_Cart_Functionality.description: Add to Cart buttons work, requires authentication (shows 'Please login to add items to cart' toast)

features: Uses cmdk (Command) and Popover for dropdown with search
Search input at top of dropdown filters options as user types
Options can have label and description
Disabled state when no options or dependent selection not made
